goal: Is ke baad aap barabar size ki do matrices ko add aur subtract kar sakein ge, kisi matrix ka transpose nikaal sakein ge, aur bata sakein ge ke result ka size kya hoga.
warmup: Do dukaandaar ek table rakhte hain ke har din kitne pens aur copies bechi gayin: rows dukaanein hain aur columns din hain. Dono dukaanon ki total sale janne ke liye aap pehli dukaan ka number doosri dukaan ke number mein add karte hain, us SAME din ke liye. Yeh tab hi ho sakta hai jab dono tables ki shape ek jaisi ho. Ab socho ke table ko ghuma diya jaye ke dukaanein columns ban jayein aur din rows ban jayein. Yehi transpose hai.
definition: Matrix addition do aisi matrices ko add karti hai jin ka order same ho (rows ki tadaad bhi same aur columns ki tadaad bhi same). Har element ko us element se add kiya jata hai jo same position par ho: C[i][j] = A[i][j] + B[i][j]. Result ka order bhi wahi hota hai. Subtraction bhi isi tarah hoti hai, bas minus ki sign ke saath. Kisi matrix ka transpose us ki rows ko columns bana deta hai: T[j][i] = M[i][j]. 2 x 3 matrix 3 x 2 matrix ban jati hai. Square matrix (rows = columns) ka transpose same size ka hota hai.
howItWorks: Addition ke liye do nested loops use karein. Bahar wala loop i rows par chalta hai aur andar wala loop j columns par. Har step mein A se (i, j) wala element lein, B se (i, j) wala element lein, dono ko add karein aur result C ke (i, j) par store kar dein. Subtraction mein sirf + ki jagah - aa jata hai. Transpose ke liye loops ORIGINAL matrix M par chalte hain (i us ki rows par, j us ke columns par) aur M[i][j] ko T[j][i] mein copy karte hain. Indexes ki jagah badal jati hai, is liye result ke sizes bhi ulte honge: agar M 2 x 3 hai to T ko T[3][2] declare karna hoga. Jab T print karein to loops ko T ke sizes use karne chahiye (3 rows, 2 columns). C++ mein arrays ke liye C = A + B nahi likh sakte. Aap ko element by element add karna hoga.
